Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_ContainerR: Tiles from the opening container to show eligible storage on the same floor. Used when Whole Building is off or no building is available.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_WholeBuild: Discover loaded containers in the current building. Enabled by default; the configuration menu initially shows the current room. Existing saved values are preserved.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_ClassifyTo: Place tagged multipurpose tools in Tools and maintenance. Disable to prefer their weapon type. The server controls category routing.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_SortBatchS: Legacy saved setting; no longer used. Sorting carries are sized by available carry weight. Vanilla transfer groups and timing are unchanged.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_RouteOptim: Load one carry before walking. Enabled: group destinations in the same building and floor, or a nearby area outdoors, per carry. Disabled: one destination container per carry. Carry size follows available weight and native capacity. Vanilla transfer groups and timing stay unchanged. Server controlled; existing saves default to enabled.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_CustomRoom: Allow server-owned custom room geometry and room-scoped physical-container sorting. Existing saves default to enabled; no rooms are created automatically.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_RoomTileLi: Maximum selected tiles in each new or edited logical room. Existing oversized rooms are retained; shrinking or deleting them remains possible. Server controlled; default 1024.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_RoomEditRa: Maximum horizontal distance from the editing player to each confirmed tile. Tiles must already be loaded and accessible. Server controlled; default 30 tiles.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_RoomDoorwa: Treat verified doorless doorway edges as automatic-detection boundaries. Actual doors and windows remain boundaries regardless of this setting. Detection is a preview only; manual geometry can cross walls and doors. Default enabled.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_CarryAllow: Extra weight above the normal carry limit allowed while fetching items for Sort or Shopping. Server controlled, 0 to 40 kg in 1 kg steps; default 0 preserves existing saves. Native container capacity and access restrictions still apply. Higher values may cause encumbrance and injury.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerBase: Seconds charged once at the first confirmed inspection. Server controlled; 0-120, default 10. Native timed-action modifiers and walking time remain additional.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerCont: Seconds for each physically inspected compartment. Server controlled; 1-15, default 5. Only confirmed completed inspections are recorded.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerEntr: Seconds per distinct recorded entry, using conservative native stack equivalence. Server controlled; 1-5, default 1.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerBurn: Seconds required to copy a completed paper ledger at a powered desktop computer. Server controlled; 10-120, default 30. One compatible vanilla CD is converted; paper is retained.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_RequireLed: Require fresh ledger for Room/Building Sort

When automatic paper-ledger updates are off, require fresh paper or powered computer knowledge for Room/Building Sort. Inventory/selected-container Sort remains available without it. When automatic updates are on, use its carried-paper and writing-tool workflow instead.
Require a ledger for Shopping collection
Require a fresh completed location ledger for Shopping collection. Planning and list editing remain available. Disabled Ledger mode bypasses this requirement.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerComp: Maximum horizontal distance in tiles for an out-of-building computer, on the same floor. Computers in the same native building may be used at any distance. The loaded CD must still cover the work location. Server controlled; 1-30 tiles, default 10.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_PhysicalSh: Store shopping plans on separate carried paper lists that can be handed to other players. Enabled by default, including existing saves. Previous personal plans remain available for explicit one-time import. Disabling restores the previous personal plan; paper records are retained.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_ShoppingWr: Require a carried notebook and a pen or pencil to create or edit physical shopping lists. Retain both supplies; consume one blank sheet for each new list. Reading an existing list and collecting from it need no writing supplies. Applies when physical shopping lists are enabled.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerMode: No updates - live statistics without expiry

Periodic: record storage once per Update interval; show live confirmed contents of recorded compartments until expiry. Disabled: no ledger, CD or computer features, and no ledger requirement. No updates: completed records never expire and show live statistics. Historical: show the actual recorded snapshot, including inaccurate old quantities after storage changes; update it before expiry for Room/Building Sort. Inventory and selected-container Sort always work without a ledger. Existing records are preserved in all modes.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerUpda: Days after a completed inspection before it expires in Periodic and Historical modes. Range 1-365; default 7. Expired records remain readable as history. Uses server world age and survives restart. No effect in Disabled/No updates modes or for automatically updating computers.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerComp: When enabled, record storage and write/load an updated CD when the ledger expires. When disabled, a powered computer refreshes without expiry only inside the exact building recorded by its loaded ledger. Off-site and safehouse-wide CDs show recorded inventory under normal expiry.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_Allocation: Off disables advisory work. Shadow compares percentage profiles with the legacy sorter without enforcing quotas or moving items. Existing saves default to Shadow. Enforcement is unavailable until native and dedicated acceptance.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_PrimaryOve: Default Primary fill threshold for newly created room allocation profiles. Server controlled, 0–100%, default 60. Existing explicit room values remain unchanged.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_SecondaryR: Default Secondary fill threshold for newly created room allocation profiles. Server controlled, 0–100%, default 80. Existing explicit room values remain unchanged.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_RequireCom: Require a found Quartermaster Application CD to install the app on each PC before ledger-CD reading, CD writing or automatic computer ledger access. Default enabled, including existing PCs. Existing paper/CD records are preserved. Disable to retain immediate computer access. Paper workflows and ordinary inventory/container Sort are unchanged.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_Applicatio: Native action duration to install Quartermaster from its genuine loaded Application CD. Range 5-120 seconds; default 20. Movement, power/access loss or cancellation prevents completion. The CD is retained.

Relative loot-table weight in commercial office desks/counters, office supply shelves/crates and computer store/stock containers. Range 0-10; default 1. Zero disables these drops. Not a percentage. Only affects new native loot rolls; existing containers and items are not changed. Restart to apply distribution settings.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_SortUpdate: Default on. Every Sort requires a carried Supply Sheet and a pen or pencil. First search accessible loaded building storage for a completed ledger covering the location and pick it up through normal transfer. Otherwise use a carried blank or unfinished sheet. Write confirmed touched storage after the whole successful Sort. Blank sheets remain partial; unvisited entries are not made fresh. Computers do not replace paper in this mode. Off restores the previous sorting requirements. Disabled Ledger mode bypasses this option.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_StockEnabl: Enable shared room/building stock targets and ledger stock views.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_StockCheck: Seconds between PC stock-check rounds. Only authorized, recorded storage is read; no per-frame inventory scans.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDQuartermaster_LedgerMult: Allow the PC app to read newest local ledger CDs and combine linked powered PCs. A completed CD brought to this PC shows dated history for an offline building; live counts require a loaded, powered PC in that building.
